legacy_system_security.name: Legacy System Decommissioning Gap
legacy_system_security.description: Improperly decommissioned cloud resources create persistent security vulnerabilities

case_study.issue: Legacy third-party cloud storage system from 2020 not properly decommissioned
case_study.impact: Access to internal operational documents, <25% of merchant base affected
case_study.no_impact: Payment platform, merchant funds, card numbers - all secure
case_study.response: Refused ransom payment, donated equivalent to cybersecurity research

legacy_system_security.lesson: Active decommissioning is critical - systems don't die gracefully on their own

mitigation.strategy: Quarterly cloud resource audits with automated cleanup
implementation: Audit all GCP resources (Storage, IAM, SQL, Run)
Identify unused resources (no access in 90+ days)
Implement automated alerts for orphaned resources
Review and remove overly broad IAM permissions
mitigation.timeline: Implement audit this week, quarterly reviews ongoing
mitigation.expected_impact: Eliminate legacy attack surface, reduce cost, improve compliance

current_risk_areas: Old Cloud Storage buckets from early development
Deprecated service accounts with lingering permissions
Archived Cloud SQL snapshots with potentially sensitive data
Legacy Cloud Run revisions with outdated configurations

multi_cloud_data_transfer_costs.name: Hidden Multi-Cloud Data Transfer Costs
multi_cloud_data_transfer_costs.description: Internet egress charges can equal or exceed compute costs in multi-cloud architectures

before.shocking_discovery: Data transfer costs equal server costs!

case_study.root_cause: Multi-cloud architecture for resilience caused massive inter-cloud transfer fees

multi_cloud_data_transfer_costs.lesson: Data transfer is expensive and often hidden - monitor aggressively

mitigation.strategy: Same-region resources, monitor egress, batch external calls
implementation: Implement cost monitoring script (GCP Billing API)
Set up alerts for data transfer > 10% of total cost
Keep all services in same GCP region
Batch external API calls to minimize requests
Use Cloud CDN for static content delivery
when_to_consider_migration: Team has DevOps expertise for self-management
when_not_to_migrate: Benefits of managed services outweigh cost savings
